chunks: From him, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, who said:
I asked Abā Ibrāhīm عليه السلام about a man who misses the witr. He said: He makes it up as witr, always.

key_terms.أَبَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Abā Ibrāhīm, the Imam عليه السلام being asked
key_terms.أَبَدًا: always; consistently in every such case
key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: a man; the person concerned in the ruling
key_terms.وِتْرًا: as witr; in the form of the original witr prayer
key_terms.يَفُوتُهُ: it escapes him; he misses performing it in its time
key_terms.يَقْضِيهِ: he makes it up; he performs its qaḍāʾ

ai.seo_question: How should a missed witr prayer be made up according to Imam Abā Ibrāhīm عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who misses the witr prayer. Imam Abā Ibrāhīm عليه السلام states that it should be made up as witr consistently, indicating the prescribed manner of its qaḍāʾ.
